migrations.name: 0005_identity_providers.sql
migrations.sql:
-- Identity providers (OpenID Connect). Apply as a NEW numbered migration after
-- the accounts schema. Every statement is IF NOT EXISTS, so a store that applied
-- an earlier version of this file applies the current one again as its next
-- migration and gains only what it lacks.
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS oa_oidc_transactions (
  state_hash TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  binding_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
  config_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
  payload TEXT NOT NULL,
  expires_at INTEGER NOT NULL
);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS oa_oidc_transactions_expiry ON oa_oidc_transactions(expires_at);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS oa_oidc_limits (
  bucket TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  count INTEGER NOT NULL,
  expires_at INTEGER NOT NULL
);
-- One pinned link per configured provider. Linking stores the issuer, JWKS URI,
-- client id, endpoints and allowed algorithms; a changed configuration only
-- records a pending re-link, which the owner completes with a step-up proof.
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS oa_identity_providers (
  provider_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  preset TEXT NOT NULL,
  status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(status IN ('linked','unlinked')),
  issuer TEXT NOT NULL,
  client_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  jwks_uri TEXT NOT NULL,
  authorization_endpoint TEXT NOT NULL,
  token_endpoint TEXT NOT NULL,
  algorithms TEXT NOT NULL,
  token_auth_method TEXT NOT NULL,
  response_iss INTEGER NOT NULL,
  interface_version TEXT,
  linked_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  pending_issuer TEXT,
  pending_client_id TEXT,
  pending_preset TEXT,
  pending_at INTEGER,
  jwks TEXT,
  jwks_fetched_at INTEGER
);
-- Reachability per configured provider, linked or not. A provider that has
-- failed discovery or JWKS for 5 minutes, or answered 404 or a DNS failure, is
-- hidden from the sign-in page until a later check succeeds.
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS oa_identity_provider_health (
  provider_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  failing_since INTEGER,
  hard_failure_at INTEGER,
  checked_at INTEGER NOT NULL
);

migrations.sql:
-- Coaster: one business, its people, claims with receipt bytes, decisions,
-- reimbursement batches, agent proposals and imported history.
-- Money is integer minor units of the one business currency.

CREATE TABLE c_business (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK (id = 1),
  name TEXT NOT NULL,
  currency TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(currency) = 3),
  timezone TEXT NOT NULL,
  mileage_rate_minor INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (mileage_rate_minor >= 0),
  per_diem_minor INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (per_diem_minor >= 0),
  receipt_threshold_minor INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (receipt_threshold_minor >= 0),
  updated_at TEXT NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE c_categories (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  name TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  account_code TEXT NOT NULL,
  tax_code TEXT NOT NULL,
  limit_minor INTEGER CHECK (limit_minor IS NULL OR limit_minor >= 0),
  active INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK (active IN (0, 1))
);

-- Coaster roles belong to people by email; native sign-in proves who they are.
CREATE TABLE c_members (
  email TEXT PRIMARY KEY CHECK (email = lower(email)),
  name TEXT NOT NULL,
  is_employee INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (is_employee IN (0, 1)),
  is_manager INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (is_manager IN (0, 1)),
  is_finance INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (is_finance IN (0, 1)),
  approver_email TEXT,
  active INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK (active IN (0, 1)),
  updated_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  CHECK (approver_email IS NULL OR approver_email <> email)
);

CREATE TABLE c_receipts (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  claim_id TEXT REFERENCES c_claims(id),
  proposal_id TEXT REFERENCES c_proposals(id),
  owner_email TEXT NOT NULL,
  name TEXT NOT NULL,
  media_type TEXT NOT NULL,
  size INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (size > 0),
  sha256 TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(sha256) = 64),
  bytes BLOB NOT NULL,
  source TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (source IN ('upload', 'camera', 'agent')),
  uploaded_by TEXT NOT NULL,
  uploaded_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  CHECK (length(bytes) = size)
);
CREATE INDEX c_receipts_claim ON c_receipts(claim_id);
CREATE INDEX c_receipts_hash ON c_receipts(sha256);
CREATE TRIGGER c_receipts_keep_bytes BEFORE UPDATE OF bytes, sha256, size, name, uploaded_by, uploaded_at ON c_receipts
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'receipt evidence is permanent'); END;
CREATE TRIGGER c_receipts_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON c_receipts
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'receipt evidence is permanent'); END;

CREATE TABLE c_claims (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  number INTEGER NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  employee_email TEXT NOT NULL,
  approver_email TEXT,
  title TEXT NOT NULL,
  status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('draft', 'submitted', 'returned', 'approved', 'rejected', 'batched', 'reimbursed')),
  revision INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (revision >= 0),
  version INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
  total_minor INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (total_minor >= 0),
  currency TEXT NOT NULL,
  prepared_by TEXT,
  batch_id TEXT REFERENCES c_batches(id),
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  updated_at TEXT NOT NULL
);
CREATE INDEX c_claims_employee ON c_claims(employee_email);
CREATE INDEX c_claims_approver ON c_claims(approver_email);

CREATE TABLE c_items (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  claim_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES c_claims(id),
  position INTEGER NOT NULL,
  kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (kind IN ('receipt', 'mileage', 'per_diem')),
  spent_on TEXT NOT NULL,
  merchant TEXT NOT NULL,
  description TEXT NOT NULL,
  amount_minor INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (amount_minor > 0),
  distance_hundredths INTEGER CHECK (distance_hundredths IS NULL OR distance_hundredths > 0),
  days INTEGER CHECK (days IS NULL OR days > 0),
  rate_minor INTEGER CHECK (rate_minor IS NULL OR rate_minor > 0),
  receipt_id TEXT REFERENCES c_receipts(id),
  explanation TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT ''
);
CREATE INDEX c_items_claim ON c_items(claim_id, position);

CREATE TABLE c_allocations (
  item_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES c_items(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  position INTEGER NOT NULL,
  category_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES c_categories(id),
  cost_centre TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  amount_minor INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (amount_minor > 0),
  PRIMARY KEY (item_id, position)
);

-- Each submission freezes the exact claim: items, allocations, receipt links
-- and the exceptions found. Revisions and decisions are never rewritten.
CREATE TABLE c_revisions (
  claim_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES c_claims(id),
  revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (revision > 0),
  submitted_by TEXT NOT NULL,
  submitted_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  total_minor INTEGER NOT NULL,
  snapshot TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (json_valid(snapshot)),
  PRIMARY KEY (claim_id, revision)
);
CREATE TRIGGER c_revisions_append_only BEFORE UPDATE ON c_revisions BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'claim history is permanent'); END;
CREATE TRIGGER c_revisions_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON c_revisions BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'claim history is permanent'); END;

CREATE TABLE c_decisions (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  claim_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  revision INTEGER NOT NULL,
  decision TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (decision IN ('approved', 'returned', 'rejected')),
  reason TEXT NOT NULL,
  actor_email TEXT NOT NULL,
  at TEXT NOT NULL,
  exceptions TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (json_valid(exceptions)),
  FOREIGN KEY (claim_id, revision) REFERENCES c_revisions(claim_id, revision),
  UNIQUE (claim_id, revision)
);
CREATE TRIGGER c_decisions_append_only BEFORE UPDATE ON c_decisions BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'claim history is permanent'); END;
CREATE TRIGGER c_decisions_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON c_decisions BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'claim history is permanent'); END;

CREATE TABLE c_batches (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  number INTEGER NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('draft', 'approved', 'reimbursed')),
  currency TEXT NOT NULL,
  total_minor INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  version INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
  created_by TEXT NOT NULL,
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  prepared_by TEXT,
  reviewed_by TEXT,
  reviewed_at TEXT,
  paid_reference TEXT,
  paid_on TEXT,
  paid_by TEXT
);

CREATE TABLE c_batch_claims (
  batch_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES c_batches(id),
  claim_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES c_claims(id),
  revision INTEGER NOT NULL,
  amount_minor INTEGER NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (batch_id, claim_id)
);

-- One exact expense reimburses once: the receipt bytes' SHA-256, or for an
-- expense without a receipt its employee, date, kind, merchant and amount.
CREATE TABLE c_reimbursement_keys (
  key TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  batch_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES c_batches(id),
  claim_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES c_claims(id),
  item_id TEXT NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE c_events (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  seq INTEGER NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  at TEXT NOT NULL,
  actor_email TEXT NOT NULL,
  action TEXT NOT NULL,
  claim_id TEXT,
  batch_id TEXT,
  detail TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}' CHECK (json_valid(detail))
);
CREATE INDEX c_events_claim ON c_events(claim_id);
CREATE INDEX c_events_batch ON c_events(batch_id);
CREATE TRIGGER c_events_append_only BEFORE UPDATE ON c_events BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'history is permanent'); END;
CREATE TRIGGER c_events_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON c_events BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'history is permanent'); END;

-- Agent keys prepare work for one person; only that person's native session
-- accepts it. Keys are stored as hashes and never travel in an export.
CREATE TABLE c_agent_keys (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  member_email TEXT NOT NULL,
  label TEXT NOT NULL,
  token_hash TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  revoked_at TEXT
);

CREATE TABLE c_proposals (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (kind IN ('claim', 'batch')),
  agent_label TEXT NOT NULL,
  for_email TEXT NOT NULL,
  payload TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (json_valid(payload)),
  status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('proposed', 'accepted', 'declined')),
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  decided_by TEXT,
  decided_at TEXT,
  result_id TEXT
);

-- Inert history written by the move-in kit (Base import-kit target rows).
CREATE TABLE c_history (
  destination TEXT NOT NULL,
  kind TEXT NOT NULL,
  id TEXT NOT NULL,
  revision TEXT NOT NULL,
  value TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (json_valid(value)),
  PRIMARY KEY (destination, kind, id)
);

-- A failing row aborts the whole write batch (authority or version changed).
CREATE TABLE c_guard (ok INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (ok = 1));

migrations.name: 0023_comments.sql
migrations.sql:
-- Comments and questions without a decision (APPROVE-006). Anyone who can see a
-- claim comments on it or on one expense, or asks a named person a question;
-- the named person's reply answers it. Comments never touch the claim's state.
-- They are history: never deleted, and frozen once anyone has replied.
CREATE TABLE c_comments (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  claim_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES c_claims(id),
  item_id TEXT,
  parent_id TEXT,
  author_email TEXT NOT NULL,
  on_behalf_of TEXT,
  asks_email TEXT,
  body TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(body) BETWEEN 1 AND 2000),
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  edited_at TEXT,
  CHECK (parent_id IS NULL OR asks_email IS NULL)
);
CREATE INDEX c_comments_claim ON c_comments(claim_id, created_at);
CREATE INDEX c_comments_parent ON c_comments(parent_id);
CREATE TRIGGER c_comments_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON c_comments BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'claim history is permanent'); END;
CREATE TRIGGER c_comments_frozen BEFORE UPDATE ON c_comments
  WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM c_comments r WHERE r.parent_id=OLD.id) OR NEW.id IS NOT OLD.id OR NEW.claim_id IS NOT OLD.claim_id OR NEW.item_id IS NOT OLD.item_id
    OR NEW.parent_id IS NOT OLD.parent_id OR NEW.author_email IS NOT OLD.author_email OR NEW.on_behalf_of IS NOT OLD.on_behalf_of OR NEW.asks_email IS NOT OLD.asks_email OR NEW.created_at IS NOT OLD.created_at
  BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'claim history is permanent'); END;

migrations.sql:
-- Recurring expenses and stipends (CLAIM-009). Finance sets allowances: a fixed
-- stipend paid each period without a receipt, or a cap expenses are claimed
-- against; employees set their own recurring expenses. Each period's stipend or
-- recurring draft is created once by the hourly run.
--
-- A stipend is its own expense kind, so c_items is rebuilt to widen its kind
-- check. Dropping c_items cascades to c_allocations (ON DELETE CASCADE), so the
-- allocations are kept aside first and put back once the new table is in place.
CREATE TABLE c_items_new (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  claim_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES c_claims(id),
  position INTEGER NOT NULL,
  kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (kind IN ('receipt', 'mileage', 'per_diem', 'stipend')),
  spent_on TEXT NOT NULL,

  on_behalf_of TEXT,
  channel TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (channel = 'app'),
  PRIMARY KEY (receipt_id,sequence),
  CHECK ((kind = 'merged') = (survivor_id IS NOT NULL) AND (survivor_id IS NULL OR survivor_id <> receipt_id))
);
INSERT INTO c_capture_lifecycle_next(receipt_id,sequence,kind,reason,at,actor_email,on_behalf_of,channel)
  SELECT receipt_id,sequence,kind,reason,at,actor_email,on_behalf_of,channel FROM c_capture_lifecycle;

ALTER TABLE c_capture_lifecycle_next RENAME TO c_capture_lifecycle;
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX c_capture_lifecycle_terminal ON c_capture_lifecycle(receipt_id) WHERE kind IN ('discarded','merged');

CREATE TRIGGER c_capture_lifecycle_keep_facts BEFORE UPDATE OF receipt_id,sequence,kind,survivor_id,at,channel ON c_capture_lifecycle
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'receipt lifecycle is permanent'); END;
CREATE TRIGGER c_capture_lifecycle_keep_identity BEFORE UPDATE OF actor_email,on_behalf_of,reason ON c_capture_lifecycle WHEN NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM c_capture_erasing)
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'receipt lifecycle is permanent'); END;
CREATE TRIGGER c_capture_lifecycle_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON c_capture_lifecycle
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'receipt lifecycle is permanent'); END;
-- Expanded replacements are retained, never truncated. Only an identical-hash merge may carry no reason.
CREATE TRIGGER c_capture_lifecycle_reason_insert BEFORE INSERT ON c_capture_lifecycle
WHEN typeof(NEW.reason)<>'text' OR length(CAST(NEW.reason AS BLOB)) NOT BETWEEN (CASE NEW.kind WHEN 'merged' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) AND 22000
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'receipt reason exceeds its byte bound'); END;
CREATE TRIGGER c_capture_lifecycle_reason_update BEFORE UPDATE OF reason ON c_capture_lifecycle
WHEN NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM c_capture_erasing) OR OLD.reason=''
  OR typeof(NEW.reason)<>'text' OR length(CAST(NEW.reason AS BLOB)) NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 22000
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'receipt reason is permanent outside bounded erasure'); END;
-- A survivor is the same employee's own original that has no terminal disposition yet; a merge without
-- identical SHA-256 states its reason.
CREATE TRIGGER c_capture_lifecycle_merge_insert BEFORE INSERT ON c_capture_lifecycle
WHEN NEW.kind='merged' AND NOT EXISTS(
  SELECT 1 FROM c_capture_receipts d JOIN c_capture_receipts s ON s.owner_email=d.owner_email AND s.id=NEW.survivor_id
  WHERE d.id=NEW.receipt_id AND NEW.at>=s.uploaded_at AND (NEW.reason<>'' OR s.sha256=d.sha256)
    AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM c_capture_lifecycle t WHERE t.receipt_id=s.id AND t.kind IN ('discarded','merged')))
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'a merge needs its own open survivor and, unless identical, a reason'); END;

-- The retained original is the masked file: the bytes below never hold a full card number.
CREATE TABLE c_statement_files (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  name TEXT NOT NULL,
  format TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (format IN ('ofx', 'qfx', 'csv')),
  issuer TEXT NOT NULL,
  fingerprint TEXT NOT NULL,
  sha256 TEXT NOT NULL,
  size INTEGER NOT NULL,
  bytes BLOB NOT NULL,
  period_start TEXT,
  period_end TEXT,
  mapping TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (json_valid(mapping)),

);
CREATE INDEX c_statement_files_fingerprint ON c_statement_files(fingerprint);
CREATE TRIGGER c_statement_files_immutable BEFORE UPDATE ON c_statement_files
  WHEN NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM c_erasing) AND (OLD.undone_at IS NOT NULL OR NEW.id IS NOT OLD.id OR NEW.bytes IS NOT OLD.bytes OR NEW.sha256 IS NOT OLD.sha256 OR NEW.fingerprint IS NOT OLD.fingerprint OR NEW.imported_by IS NOT OLD.imported_by OR NEW.charges IS NOT OLD.charges OR NEW.total_minor IS NOT OLD.total_minor)
  BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'a statement file is permanent; only its undo is recorded'); END;
CREATE TRIGGER c_statement_files_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON c_statement_files BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'a statement file is permanent'); END;

-- One charge per statement transaction. transaction_key is the COA-005 exact key for card spend.
CREATE TABLE c_card_charges (

CREATE TRIGGER c_card_charges_immutable BEFORE UPDATE ON c_card_charges WHEN NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM c_erasing)

CREATE TRIGGER c_card_charges_undo_only BEFORE DELETE ON c_card_charges

-- FEED-005 card statement reconciliation and liability clearing (statement-file door). A statement record is one card's
-- statement period read from a retained masked original; its differences are derived from that original and the card
-- charges, so only the finance person's resolutions and the closing ledger entries are stored. Closing is permanent.
CREATE TABLE c_card_statements (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  file_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES c_statement_files(id),
  card_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES c_cards(id),
  period_start TEXT,
  period_end TEXT NOT NULL,
  opening_minor INTEGER NOT NULL,
  statement_minor INTEGER NOT NULL,
  opened_by TEXT NOT NULL,
  opened_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  closed_by TEXT,
  closed_at TEXT,
  UNIQUE (file_id, card_id),
  CHECK ((closed_at IS NULL) = (closed_by IS NULL))
);
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX c_card_statements_closed_period ON c_card_statements(card_id, period_end) WHERE closed_at IS NOT NULL;
CREATE TRIGGER c_card_statements_closed_permanent BEFORE UPDATE ON c_card_statements
  WHEN OLD.closed_at IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM c_erasing)
  BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'a closed card statement is permanent'); END;
CREATE TRIGGER c_card_statements_keep_source BEFORE UPDATE OF id, file_id, card_id, period_start, period_end ON c_card_statements
  BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'a card statement keeps its source file, card and period'); END;
CREATE TRIGGER c_card_statements_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON c_card_statements BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'a card statement is permanent'); END;

-- One resolution per statement line: a missing charge is added as a card expense or explained; a credit is acknowledged.
CREATE TABLE c_card_statement_resolutions (
  statement_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES c_card_statements(id),
  line INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (line > 0),
  resolution TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (resolution IN ('add', 'explain', 'credit')),
  amount_minor INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (amount_minor > 0),
  charge_id TEXT,
  note TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '' CHECK (length(note) <= 500),
  resolved_by TEXT NOT NULL,
  resolved_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (statement_id, line),
  CHECK (resolution = 'add' OR note <> '' OR (resolution = 'credit' AND charge_id IS NOT NULL))
);
CREATE TRIGGER c_card_statement_resolutions_open BEFORE INSERT ON c_card_statement_resolutions
  WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM c_card_statements s WHERE s.id=NEW.statement_id AND s.closed_at IS NOT NULL)
  BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'a closed card statement is permanent'); END;
CREATE TRIGGER c_card_statement_resolutions_permanent BEFORE UPDATE ON c_card_statement_resolutions
  WHEN NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM c_erasing)
  BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'a statement resolution is permanent'); END;
CREATE TRIGGER c_card_statement_resolutions_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON c_card_statement_resolutions BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'a statement resolution is permanent'); END;

-- The native card liability ledger: one double entry per line, written once when its statement closes. ACCT-001 to
-- ACCT-003 will carry these entries to the connected ledger; until then the card account is read here.
CREATE TABLE c_card_ledger (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  statement_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES c_card_statements(id),
  card_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES c_cards(id),
  seq INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (seq > 0),
  kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (kind IN ('opening', 'purchase', 'unmatched', 'credit', 'payment', 'fee', 'interest')),
  debit_account TEXT NOT NULL,
  credit_account TEXT NOT NULL,
  amount_minor INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (amount_minor > 0),
  ref TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  memo TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  posted_on TEXT NOT NULL,
  posted_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  UNIQUE (statement_id, seq),
  CHECK (debit_account <> credit_account)
);
CREATE INDEX c_card_ledger_card ON c_card_ledger(card_id, posted_at, seq);
CREATE TRIGGER c_card_ledger_with_close BEFORE INSERT ON c_card_ledger
  WHEN NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM c_card_statements s WHERE s.id=NEW.statement_id AND s.card_id=NEW.card_id AND s.closed_at=NEW.posted_at)
  BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'ledger entries are written only when their statement closes'); END;
CREATE TRIGGER c_card_ledger_permanent BEFORE UPDATE ON c_card_ledger BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'a ledger entry is permanent'); END;
CREATE TRIGGER c_card_ledger_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON c_card_ledger BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'a ledger entry is permanent'); END;

-- PAY-002: employee bank details held as a provider token (sealed) and the last four digits only, with change protection.
CREATE TABLE c_bank_providers (
  provider TEXT PRIMARY KEY CHECK(provider IN ('plaid','stripe')),
  credentials_sealed TEXT NOT NULL,
  connected_by TEXT NOT NULL,
  connected_at TEXT NOT NULL
);
CREATE TABLE c_bank_settings (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK(id=1),
  hold_days INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(hold_days BETWEEN 1 AND 30),
  set_by TEXT NOT NULL,
  set_at TEXT NOT NULL
);
INSERT INTO c_bank_settings(id,hold_days,set_by,set_at) VALUES(1,2,'default','2026-10-27T00:00:00.000Z');
CREATE TABLE c_bank_accounts (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  member_email TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES c_members(email),
  provider TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(provider IN ('plaid','stripe')),
  method TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(method IN ('instant','microdeposit')),
  state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(state IN ('pending','active','replaced','abandoned')),
  token_sealed TEXT,
  last4 TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(last4)=4 AND last4 NOT GLOB '*[^0-9]*'),
  label TEXT NOT NULL,
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  verified_at TEXT,
  replaced_at TEXT,
  previous_id TEXT REFERENCES c_bank_accounts(id),
  hold_days INTEGER,
  hold_until TEXT,
  hold_released_at TEXT,
  CHECK((state IN ('pending','active'))=(token_sealed IS NOT NULL)),
  CHECK(provider<>'plaid' OR method='instant'),
  CHECK((state IN ('active','replaced'))=(verified_at IS NOT NULL)),
  CHECK((hold_until IS NULL)=(hold_days IS NULL)),
  CHECK(hold_released_at IS NULL OR hold_until IS NOT NULL)
);
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX c_bank_one_active ON c_bank_accounts(member_email) WHERE state='active';
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX c_bank_one_pending ON c_bank_accounts(member_email) WHERE state='pending';
-- An account's identity, its last four and its hold are evidence: only the state moves, the replaced or abandoned token is discarded,
-- and the hold is released once by the hourly run.
CREATE TRIGGER c_bank_evidence BEFORE UPDATE ON c_bank_accounts
WHEN NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM c_erasing) AND (NEW.id<>OLD.id OR NEW.member_email<>OLD.member_email OR NEW.provider<>OLD.provider OR NEW.method<>OLD.method
  OR NEW.last4<>OLD.last4 OR NEW.label<>OLD.label OR NEW.created_at<>OLD.created_at
  OR NOT (NEW.state=OLD.state OR (OLD.state='pending' AND NEW.state IN ('active','abandoned')) OR (OLD.state='active' AND NEW.state='replaced'))
  OR (NEW.token_sealed IS NOT OLD.token_sealed AND NOT (NEW.token_sealed IS NULL AND NEW.state IN ('replaced','abandoned')))
  OR (OLD.state<>'pending' AND (NEW.verified_at IS NOT OLD.verified_at OR NEW.previous_id IS NOT OLD.previous_id OR NEW.hold_days IS NOT OLD.hold_days OR NEW.hold_until IS NOT OLD.hold_until))
  OR (OLD.hold_released_at IS NOT NULL AND NEW.hold_released_at IS NOT OLD.hold_released_at)
  OR (NEW.replaced_at IS NOT OLD.replaced_at AND NEW.state<>'replaced'))
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'Bank account evidence is immutable'); END;
CREATE TRIGGER c_bank_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON c_bank_accounts WHEN NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM c_erasing)
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'Bank account evidence is immutable'); END;
